notes:
Status: closed-lost (final decision 2025-11-15) - lost to AtlasInference + internal procurement freeze.

Summary bullets:
- Large national rail operator focused on real-time signalling and rail-vehicle health monitoring. High safety/regulatory bar; cannot tolerate cloud egress for model inputs.
- Strict air-gapped requirement flagged during security review (must run entirely on isolated on-prem network with HSM-backed keys). Redwood Private would have been ideal but current on-prem package cannot meet their air-gapped isolation constraints without additional engineering.
- Main pain: predictive maintenance model latency and ability to run batch reranking for anomaly scoring on-site. They wanted same API surface as hosted API but fully disconnected.

Timeline (key events):
- 2025-09-04: Intro call (AE Jordan Meyers + SE Priya Anand) — initial discovery. Customer: Head of ML Ops (Marko Jensen), Senior Security Architect (Rita Gomes). Marko: "We cannot have model telemetry leave the plant network."
- 2025-09-17: Deep-dive security call (Fireflies ff-2025-09-17-3641) — infra diagrams requested; security asked for pen-test reports, SOC2 scope details, KMS integration options.
- 2025-10-01: POC kicked off (on-prem lab image) — small proof to validate inference speed with quantized model and KV cache. SE delivered test harness; performance within target for single-node but not validated for fleet-scale.
- 2025-10-21: Follow-up review (Fireflies ff-2025-10-21-4189) — security team escalated: requirement changed to fully air-gapped (no bi-directional management plane traffic). This created architecture mismatch.
- 2025-11-03: Procurement/Legal review — procurement flagged long lead hardware refresh and budget freeze for FY26.
- 2025-11-15: Final decision: procurement paused + incumbent (AtlasInference) offered a bespoke on-prem boxed appliance that matched their air-gap promise. Deal closed-lost.

Security review items (status):
- SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence: provided (drive links).
- Pen-test: customer requested 3rd-party on-site validation — not feasible before deal deadline.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood offered KMS integration but HSM on isolated LAN not fully supported in current Private build — blocker.
- Audit logging & retention policy: OK. Data residency: satisfied.

POC notes:
- Test harness: ran on a single on-prem GPU node provided by customer. Throughput met 95th pctl target for edge gateways but aggregated fleet routing behavior not tested.
- Integration friction: management plane required outbound connectivity for updates/metrics; customer's security policy forbids any outbound from control plane.

Sales cadence & health:
- Champion: Marko Jensen (ML Ops) — strong technical supporter but lacks procurement influence.
- Exec sponsor: none identified. No internal champion to push procurement through freeze.
- Procurement: froze cloud/on-prem refresh for FY26 due to macro-budget pressure.

Why we lost:
- Absolute air-gapped requirement (no outbound management/telemetry) — Redwood Private required limited control plane connectivity for updates/patches; customer would not accept that trade.
- Competitor offered appliance model with on-site HSM and certified network isolation.
- Procurement freeze and lack of executive sponsor to unblock budget.

Recommended next steps if re-engaging:
- Re-evaluate in Q4 2026 when budget re-opens; align on a pilot that accepts offline update cadence.
- Product ask: roadmap note — investigate fully-disconnected on-prem appliance path (HSM-only, manual patching flow) for regulated infra customers.
- Maintain quarterly check-ins with Marko; share any new offline deployment options and hardened HSM flow.

Stubs/refs:
- Drive: pricing-deck-v3.pdf (proposal v3), security-FAQ.docx (answers to iso/pen-test questions).
- Jira: RINF-3217 (POC infra issue), RINF-3299 (security connector request).

Short next-step line for AE: "Archived as closed-lost 2025-11-15; follow-up targeted for 2026 Q4 pending budget — re-open if champion emerges."
